Royal Flush is dealing chaos this Saturday and NOBODY at Azucar is safe 🃏💋 Victoria DeMizer and Anita BigDee are running the show, stirring up punchlines and pageantry until the Main Floor can't take it anymore. Liquor, Puddles, and Missy are bringing the looks AND the laughs — think stand-up meets drag meets full send. This is the comedy revue that turns strangers into a room full of witnesses. Grab tickets online before door price hits, because this hand sells out. Dirty humor, big wigs, bigger reactions — you've been warned 😈✨

You feel it before you even find your seat 🔥🎶
